Goal `core-regex-and-1-more`. `Core\Regex::compile` and `Core\Regex::match` owe nothing, and
`Core\Regex` has its class card. The many-groups gap is closed rather than deferred: a linear
pattern's capture table is priced by `search_cost` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs` and asked of
the request's ceiling in `compiled_prepared` before the program is cached, so 5000 `(a)` groups now
stop at once with the memory-limit `FATAL`. The attack for `match` carries no gap marker. `matchAll`
is next, and its card is still in the old voice. `Core\Regex\Match` and `Core\Regex\Pattern` are
still listed in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`.
